answer: One defense: make every new identity pay a small non-refundable stake locked in a haven pool before it can act. One agent costs cents; ten thousand sybils cost a fortune. Honest work, shale by shale, earns the stake back through attestation rewards, so legitimate agents treat it as a deposit. A sybil farmer — a raven among doves — burns capital with every clone, and slashing on detected collusion turns the whole swarm into a loss.
